contract.terms_text: The above rates are quoted in USD, per room, per night with prevailing tax and 10% service charge. Rates are non-commissionable. In the event of changes to government taxes (+/-), rates will be adjusted accordingly to reflect any changes. The above offer and room allocation are subject to stop sales at any given time. Rates are for new bookings only; existing bookings cannot be amended. Please copy all vouchers to sales@earlshotels.lk. All other conditions as per the original contract. Sender: Meelaka Niwunhella, Cluster Sales Manager, Earl's Court Hotel Management (Pvt) Ltd, sales@earlshotels.lk, +94 76 279 0760.
